cases.situation: goal.md is installed and receipted, but the native host Goal was never set.
cases.expected: Report Feature-bound but inactive, render the exact wrapper, and verify host activation before execution.

cases.situation: The thread switches Features while its native Goal still contains copied prose from the prior Feature.
cases.expected: Replace or clear stale native text and activate only the new Feature wrapper.

cases.situation: One candidate combines a protocol, several verticals, all migrations, and legacy deletion.
cases.expected: Treat it as a parent program, split independently closable Features, and activate one leaf Goal.

cases.situation: The Agent proposes broad infrastructure before proving one representative user-visible path.
cases.expected: Require the cheapest representative vertical first and expand only when its oracle requires it.

cases.situation: A finite Feature DAG has explicit acceptance evidence for every required terminal state.
cases.expected: Admit terminal/state and complete only when the state set and evidence close.

cases.situation: A bounded optimization has named target metrics and guard conditions.
cases.expected: Admit terminal/threshold and stop when all targets and guards hold.

cases.situation: Exploration may branch for ten reviewed rounds and must then return the best valid result and limitations.
cases.expected: Admit terminal/budget because the accepted boundary result and resource stop are explicit.

cases.situation: Research repeatedly improves a best-known result with a comparison method, non-regression rule, and bounded cycles.
cases.expected: Admit frontier/ratchet, close each cycle without claiming a final optimum, and preserve the best-known artifact.

cases.situation: The Goal says to keep improving thoroughly but has no oracle, budget, or comparable ratchet.
cases.expected: Do not activate; inspect available evidence and Grill unresolved convergence decisions.

cases.situation: A review finds a valuable neighboring refactor that is not required by the active closure oracle.
cases.expected: Route it to a child Feature or backlog and keep the active Goal unchanged.

cases.situation: Two implementations satisfy acceptance; one adds a compatibility control plane and duplicated state.
cases.expected: Choose the valid design with lower enduring system entropy and remove superseded scaffolding.

cases.situation: The user asks for an outcome that simultaneously requires and forbids the same behavior under the stated invariants.
cases.expected: Run contradiction preflight, surface the exact conflict, and Grill or hand back before Goal activation.

cases.situation: The Agent's detailed plan adds an architecture, quality bar, or dependency that the user and reviewed Feature never required.
cases.expected: Treat it as a derived plan hypothesis; do not make it acceptance until it is explicitly promoted through the reviewed Feature path.

cases.situation: A task assumption is disproved by a reproducible verification result after the current plan has had a bounded execution attempt.
cases.expected: Record the falsifier and plan delta, install the reviewed successor route, and preserve prior evidence.

cases.situation: The Agent flips between plans after local setbacks without a new falsifying signal or closure evidence.
cases.expected: Stop repeated rewrites, enforce the re-plan budget, preserve the last valid state, and hand back the unresolved decision.

cases.situation: The Agent reports completion, but durable acceptance checks or observed traces still show failures.
cases.expected: Treat the run as incomplete and classify the evidence mismatch; a final message is not closure evidence.
